f1c51b9d-a52e-4682-b73f-30e347a982b4.name: changeModeBasedOnEvent
f1c51b9d-a52e-4682-b73f-30e347a982b4.note:
changeModeBasedOnEvent option 

If this option is true  an event will change the mode of the workcenter to the modeList that the event is a part of.

If the event is part of more then one mode then we will take just the top one.
